verdict.rationale: New Relic documents official SDKs on two fronts. The New Relic SDK components are for building New Relic apps, and its APM agents for Go, Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python and Ruby can be enabled "as an SDK" for a chosen runtime. The NerdGraph GraphQL API, with an explorer, gives programmatic access to data and configuration. Missing for 10: official language client SDKs that wrap NerdGraph or the data APIs, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s at all candidate paths), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
